mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates and boost valuation multiples, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 230 indicates elevated inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating payroll employment growth signals expanding labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 98.0 indicates weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate capacity utilization and earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in GDP and housing starts reflects broad-based economic strength that increases corporate earnings growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate hikes exceeding 0.25% in one month signal aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in one month.
